title: He led a tribal uprising against colonial exploitation. India now marks his birthday as a national day of pride.

sources.text: PIB (Ministry of Tribal Affairs) - Janjatiya Gaurav Divas

caption:
He led a tribal uprising against colonial exploitation. India now marks his birthday as a national day of pride.

He led the Ulgulan - the "Great Tumult" - a tribal uprising between 1899 and 1900 against British colonial exploitation and the exploitative land practices imposed on tribal communities.

The uprising forced the colonial government to pass the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act of 1908, protecting tribal land rights. In 2021, the Indian government instituted his birthday as Janjatiya Gaurav Divas - Tribal Pride Day - honoring tribal freedom fighters nationwide.

Birsa Munda didn't just resist colonial rule - he won a legal protection for tribal land that has outlasted him by more than a century.
